steps.name: memory of feathers
steps.objective: Defeat [Michaela] in “Hile” and obtain <Holy Angel Feather>. Then report the quest to [Medea] in “Kali.”

lines.text: (Inside Kali Village, Medea looks toward the entrance as if she senses a familiar energy. Then, she smiles brightly when she spots someone she is happy to see.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Welcome. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Looking at his expression, it looks like he didn't sleep well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a dream, but I’m not sure what it was about. However, one word still remains.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since you came to see me, you must be a ‘witch’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems that some of the witches have recognized the existence of %s. I guess something big has passed.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris I think it had some effect on you too… . How about we meet and talk?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That would be the best way.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A warm wind is blowing. Welcome, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .
(Purple iris leaves, as if blown by Kali's wind, fall nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .
(In the place where the petals that fell to the ground disappeared, Iris blooms like a flower.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Iris.
(At %s’s hand greeting, Iris smiles brightly and holds their hands.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Nice to meet you all.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Originally, I tried to take them both to my place, but I couldn't. It could be dangerous if the two of you come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I felt like there was an attempt to connect with this world through some route in the demon world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I thought it was a relief that traces of what had happened in Eastland had disappeared, but on the contrary, forces big and small are coming in various forms.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Perhaps they are so-called monarch-level beings who protect each area of the Demon World. Among them, there must be Lux... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I felt another power inside me. Trying to connect the demon world and this planet... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Witch… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s's dream may not actually be a dream. Maybe it's an unspoken warning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't disturb... ?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We need to find the witches.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know who the witches with that purpose are, where they are, or what they look like. so… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It’s okay, Iris… . I'll help you, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we should find the witches first... . If you find it, you will be able to do anything.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Right now, neither I nor %s know much, but don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll just go now. I came here just to spare some time, so I had to go back right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, be careful.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: See you later, Iris… .
(As the wind carrying the warm scent of flowers blows once again, Iris disappears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Noel sent me some nice leaves, and I should have served them for tea. Iris There’s nothing you can do… . %s, I have something to tell you. Could you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. But what are you talking about... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please wait a moment.
(After a while, Media prepares a new car and puts it in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells good.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Noel prepared it with great care, so of course it will be good. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s… . Although it's a little vague, I came up with a way to find the witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Really?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When I was young, I remember playing hide and seek with that person. I couldn't find him... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He always found me. Even when I asked how he found it, he didn't answer.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I remember there was something he was holding every time he found me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean you have the tools?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I don't remember exactly, but it had a feather on it. The white, sacred feather was always pointed towards me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: White and sacred feather... . Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's probably more to it than that, but I think that's a start.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You could ask the angel Michaela, right? I'll go to the sanctuary first and find out.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will try to recall my memories. There might be something more... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay. Don't worry too much... . Now I'm not the same person I used to be.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please come back. I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back as soon as possible.
(Medea sends off with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea's smile seems to be more comfortable than before. Then, let’s go to Hille.
(Hile is still full of red light. As soon as you enter, the angel Michaela approaches you, spreading her pure white wings that are not dyed red.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, it’s been a while… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela.
(Michaela comes closer and lightly kisses her cheek.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Greetings from Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, hello, Michaela. Sorry, sorry. Because I'm not used to it... .
(Mikaela, who was looking at %s's embarrassed expression, smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you for driving away the bad energy from afar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is doing well. What's going on today... ? Did Babotos show up?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, no, it's not about Barbatos. There's something I'd like to ask for help with... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Michaela briefly about Medea’s story.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Angel feathers are a blessing. So I believe that other beings make wishes come true.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Perhaps it depends on the object the child was found with... . I feel like I have the strength to find that child.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: And it didn't come from Mika's wings. Because there are other angels besides Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Another angel?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does this mean I might meet another angel? Hmm….)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is an angel. If you put the child's power into Mika's feather, it will become the material for the tool you want.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I'll give you Mika's wing feathers. Instead, I’ll give it to you after the sparring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I'll wait for you at the end of Mika. See you later then.
(After Michaela finishes speaking, she spreads the wings that were folded behind her back. The angel, who was looking forward to the battle, flaps her white wings and flies away somewhere in Hille.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This time, I'm sparring with Michaela... . I guess I should just think of it as a process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go?
(When Michaela flaps her wings vigorously, a strong wind rises that makes it impossible to approach.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The sparring with Mika is over. Wait a minute, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Michaela.
(Michaela nods and picks up the wing feather that fell on the floor and holds it in her hand. After a while, white light flows from the tip of the feather and surrounds her hand.
(A red world where time seems to have stopped, and the light unfolding within it fills you with a sacred feeling just by looking at it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Give Mika’s feather to the child. If you help the goddess, I will generously share Mika's power with you.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I hope this helps. Mika is happy too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: If you're grateful, give Mika a cookie as a gift later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cookies? I will. There's a place that serves desserts well, so I'll bring them next time I come.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The Glaston cookies Argent gave to Mika as thanks were also delicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent brought cookies?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum said he would give me cookies, so I went, and I met Mika Argent. He said he was thinking about a gift for his younger sister, so Mika gave him a gift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that you received the cookie and gave me the feather as a gift?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yeah.
(Michaela answers with an expression without any malice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I should have prepared the cookies in advance.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Still, the purpose is different. The feather that Mika is giving me now is more special than the birthday gift feather.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Because it's about helping the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, Michaela. This feather will help everyone.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Oh, wait a minute.
(Mikaela brings two boxes with cookie shapes drawn on them from somewhere. She puts one box into %s's hand and takes two cookies from the other box.)
(And then he puts one cookie in front of his mouth and the other cookie in front of %s's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s. This is delicious. Eat as you go. Give this to the child. There's another Mika. (mumbling)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enjoy your meal, Michaela. Then I will go.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yeah. Next time you need help, talk to Mika. (mumbling)
(Michaela puts a different flavor cookie in her mouth and flies powerfully up into the sky with a red moon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An angel with a red moon and white wings... , something strangely suits it. Anyway, it looks like it's going to be quite a long journey this time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what did I say? Hey, it could be something special. Don't think about unnecessary things, just let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, these cookies are delicious. (mumbling)

steps.name: A place where the night stays

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You’re here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela gave me a feather with sacred power.
(Mikaela's message is delivered to Medea along with the angel's sacred feather. After a while, the light emitted from the feather hovers over Medea and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since you gave me something so precious, I don't know how to repay this favor... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Uh, by the way, what are you holding in your hand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These are cookies that Michaela gave to Medea as a gift.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You gave me not only feathers but also this... . I will invite the villagers to eat together later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah… .
(Medea looks at the cookie box with a surprised expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I never thought I would remember something like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember anything?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A long time ago, that person gave me snacks and told me a certain place.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They say there is a place where stars are scattered like powder and the forests, rocks, and cliffs are all sparkling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if it’s there… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I once met a witch nearby… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you left a dream-like hint to %s, you would have left some trace there as well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please tell me the name of that place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Stardust Plain.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could you please wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes… .
(Mediah gently taps %s's shoulder with the staff she was holding.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You may not be able to find the witches right away, but we made sure that they appear in front of %s as quickly as possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I gave it a little bit of my witchy energy. There are no negative effects, so you don't need to worry. Instead, it will be a little annoying... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please help... . Now, the place of the ‘night’ they were talking about must be Freios. And things will start from a place near the Stardust Plains... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You look tired. %s's accommodation is always available, so get some rest before you leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was thinking of going straight to Dana. I guess what happened to Sister Dana... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Goddess is worried. Let's get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say that, I have no choice but to take a break.
(Medea, who finally got the answer she wanted, smiles lightly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will ask the villagers to prepare a meal. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, you look much more comfortable than before. I think you've changed a lot... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to prepare properly before I go. It will be a completely different task from finding and persuading superhumans.)

steps.name: Let's go to the gateway to the continent!
steps.objective: After talking with [Dana], go to [Jade] in the “Infinite Corridor.” Then, report the quest to [Ricotta] at the “Nereis Gate.”

lines.text: (Dana sighs, folds the letter she was holding and puts it in her bosom. Then, she spots the figure of %s approaching.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I was wondering when it would arrive, but it was today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I vaguely felt it, but it seemed like the work of a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did something happen?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Something happened recently. At Hwangseong’s request, one member is already going out and investigating.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's almost like a name to say it's helpful.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, do you know that it is the Nereis Gateway?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, this is my first time hearing it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It is a major base connecting the western and eastern parts of Freios. It can be seen as the standard for the continent, dividing it into the West and the East.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There are roads connecting the continents here and there, but they are relatively safe, so most of them pass through gateways except in special cases.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It would be best to go and find out more details.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The road to the gateway is in the Stardust Plain. I want to let you go a little more comfortably... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Show Jade the card I gave you earlier and tell her about the gateway. Then they will send you straight to the gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, it was right near the Stardust Plain….)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If you need anything, just tell the member there.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't help you this much this time. These days, I suddenly have a lot of work to do... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay. I will say it the way you told me. Thank you, Dana. Then I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah. bye.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: (Until now, my sister has never moved herself... Why, all of a sudden...)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jade.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What brought you here? Is this really a magic academy job?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about the magic academy? no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have some business to go to the Nereis Gate. Dana said it would be easier to go to Jade.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The card you are holding... . This is a card that has been certified by the imperial family.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: We will send it straight to the Nereis Gate. Could you please wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will wait.
(As Jade waves her hand, the wizards of the Infinite Corridor wearing the same robes begin to gather one by one.)
(Following Jade's instructions, the wizards chant, and a cute little magic circle is created at %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Preparation is complete. %s, please close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Feel the air flowing within this infinite corridor. And feel like a cat who wants to run out of the box.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A cat... ?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Okay, that's it. Then, space-time magic… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow! cat?!
(In an instant, the light rising from the magic circle takes Adventurer somewhere with a scream.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The explanation isn't over yet... .

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Jade, the explanation was a bit long. But what is a cat?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Not long ago, a person who brought an imperial authentication card said something like that, so I applied it to the explanation.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: By the way, I heard it was a big problem because the important cat didn't come out. What happened now?

steps.name: Please call me Rico
steps.objective: After talking to [Ricotta] at the “Nereis Gate,” go to [Edam] nearby. Then, report the quest to [Notos] at the Nereis Gate.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: The composition of the magical power that makes up the gate changed instantly. Who on earth and for what purpose... .
(Suddenly, a magic circle unfolds in front of the girl. A large light rises from the center of the magic circle, and one person falls to the floor with a strange sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow! cat!!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Are you %s?
(The girl stares at Adventurer, who is unable to get up, and stabs her with her finger. She nods at Adventurer's reaction, which momentarily flinches.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: You're alive. Then I'll help you get up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I didn't know you would pretend to faint out of embarrassment in this situation. It seems like the Infinite Corridor's space-time magic was cast extremely quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, but who… . ah… .
(The girl in black nods as if she noticed something in %s's expression.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: That's right. Just as you think... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce myself. It's called ricotta. Feel free to call me Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe something like Raclette and Zelic... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I am colleagues with two people who call me Riririko. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The difference is that the two of you do it in a place you can't see, and I do it in a place you can see. I take care of the official matters requested by the Emperor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I go into detail like this?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Dana said it was okay since Adventurer knows our work.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Here I am sorting out the strange dolls that haunt the Nereid Gate.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I heard that there are dolls somewhere that move of their own will, but the dolls that appear here are different.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's as if someone sprayed it on purpose... , As if asking someone to come and see… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm taking care of this doll, so don't worry too much about it.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: This kind of work must be done by people like me with sinister powers... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Anyway, if you want to know more about the situation here, visit Notos and Edam. Because you two work here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you just say Edam?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Do you know anyone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found out about it because of something I had to do in the past.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I see. Ah, I just happen to see Edam over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go and ask, Ricotta.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You can call me Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, Rico. See you later.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… .
(Ricotta looks around and suddenly feels a sense of déjà vu. Then, he naturally approaches the guardrail built on the cliff side of the gateway.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I feel something strange from far away... . Is this the same thing? I don’t think so… .
(A tall-looking young man tries to act casually while receiving the heated gaze of visitors.)
(As if that doesn't work, he tries to smile and passes by. Then, he seems to recognize the figure of %s approaching him and smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: You are %s. Long time no see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam? That's the guerrilla from back then, right?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: You remember me... , thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard the name from a guerrilla in Knossos. It's called Edam... .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: So you know my name. It's an honor. How have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm doing well. Although sometimes things are difficult.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I have a lot going on, but thanks to Adventurer, I'm doing well.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Currently, I am doing security, security, and other various tasks here.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I often heard about your active work, even from afar. I think it's truly amazing that you are working so hard to save so many people.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: But the fact that %s is here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had to go somewhere else in Freios.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: It must be important... . Oh, I really want to help my benefactor, %s. Just tell me and I will do everything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you say that, it’s too burdensome… . Oh, is there anything wrong?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Monsters and such appear occasionally, but I don't pay much attention to them... .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Let’s move places for a moment. I think I can tell you anything if I'm with Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Edam.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Please follow me.

steps.name: Cause of Suspicious Rumors
steps.objective: After talking to [Notos] at the “Nereis Gate,” go to the gate leading to “Aie Island.” Then, report the quest to [Yeonhee] who is stranded on “Aie Island.”

lines.text: (A young man with long blue hair and red eyes is examining a book that appears to be a magic book.)
(He had a slightly stiff expression as if something wasn't going well, but he smiled brightly as soon as he saw the person in front of him.)
Mr. Edam, you couldn't refuse gifts from visitors, so you came to leave it to me.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos, that’s not it, I’ve brought you a guest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was expecting a delicious snack, but it's a bit disappointing that it wasn't. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Is the person next to you a guest? nice to meet you

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. I am %s… no see.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My name is Wizard Notos. He is responsible for managing the Nereis Gateway Center. People who come here call me the center manager.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh, your name is %s… . right. He's famous. He led the Eastern Continent to peace... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I heard a lot of stories when I was alone in the Wise Man’s Tower.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's not that great of a person. But the Tower of the Wise? I think Notos is even more amazing... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'm just a wizard, and it's just a quiet place, perfect for researching wind magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's wind magic... , I heard that the chairman of the magic academy, Zephyrus, is also amazing.
(He smiles brightly when the name Zephyrus is mentioned.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Maybe it's because Zephyrus is more skilled than me, but a lot of people know about him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know anyone?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: This is my younger brother who looks just like me.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hahaha, everyone is surprised. The problem is that my younger brother hates me for being a twin, and I hate him too. ah… .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Mr. Notos, how about we get to the point now?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, Edam. sorry. Sorry, %s. Saddam is long. It would definitely be important if Mr. Edam brought us here... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Could you please tell me what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to know what's going on at the Nereid Gate.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hmm… . As the person in charge, I don't know how much I should say... . If you have any evidence I can trust, can you show me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this okay?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: This is a card that has been certified by Hwangseong. all right. I will tell you everything since I am someone that His Majesty has also recognized.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Nereis Gate is a kind of terminal connecting the eastern and western parts of Freios. You can go to various places in Freios through a magically powered gate.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There were rumors recently that the gate was broken. Moreover, there was a rumor going around that the people who used it were sent to other places.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Just in case, we continued to conduct inspections recently, and many experts, including wizards, looked at it, but it was determined that there were no problems.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Of course, there were no traces of users who had gone elsewhere. However, the recent appearance of strange dolls has fueled these rumors.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Where on earth did it come from? .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: First of all, we are dealing with the extermination of the dolls together with the knight from the Imperial Castle, but there is no end to it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could I please check the gate?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You can do that. Today I also checked, and together with Mr. Edam, I confirmed all the routes leading to various roads.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Although it's just a rumor, can you tell us where the people disappeared?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It is said that there is a small island somewhere between the magical vortex. They say it's a place that isn't on the map and you can't get to the gate, but... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It would be nice to check there, but I can't reach it with my wind magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As soon as I find out something, I'll let you know.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Just your words are reassuring. If you are %s, there was already an order from His Majesty to not ask for details and to trust you and leave it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It was delivered directly to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your Majesty knew this would happen...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you must be busy, but thank you for telling me. Then I will go to the gate.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: No. Edam, please go and help %s. I will step down because I have guests coming from the capital.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Okay, Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Edam. Just saying thank you. This is what I have to do... .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I see what you mean. There are several gates built inside, so take a look.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Edam.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go to the gate….)
(The moment you head to the gate at the end, the people in front of the gate disappear one by one, as if their existence is being erased.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… ?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, don't panic. Because those people are using the gate normally.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It just seems to disappear from our eyes. And those people don't recognize us now either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, what do you mean... . ah… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I was feeling ominous right now, so I came in a hurry, and it turned out to be true. I think someone tampered with the gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is a witch about to appear like Medea said?...)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It affected the functionality of the gate but not the entire gate. I guess that's why the wizards didn't discover it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be the other side, right?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Although we know the other side, the person who touched it probably has a different name. Anyway, if you use the gate in this state... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I guess I can go to the rumored place.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, come with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico is here. I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I have to go because I’m on a mission too. Exploring the other side of things is also my job.
(Ricotta’s expression is full of energy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then let's go together.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Phew, there have been many times when I discovered the other side and went in… , but I still get nervous every time I go in.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then follow me.
(Like that, Ricotta and %s slowly enter the gate that looks like someone is calling them.)
(The flow of magical power contained in the gate disperses, and a new place appears in front of the two.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It seems like a remote place, neither eastern nor western on the Freios continent. If you look at the eastern and western terrains here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looks like it's just in the middle? But the blue light you see over there... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Have you ever heard the expression that a voice fairy fell into thin air?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I've heard of it.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: This is also part of the empty sea. There is a vortex of magical power here that is stronger than the empty sea near the guild union... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think that's how they expressed the fact that when fairies or spirits come near here, they are swept away by magical power.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I didn't know that the flow of magical power could look so blue... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can see the broken apparatus and airship over there, and that is... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think I got caught up in a whirlpool while trying to cross the eastern and western sections without using the gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there any people who have drifted away? I think I'll have to go inside and check it out first.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, %s. Let's go together.
(At that time, a girl casually passes by Ricotta and makes eye contact with Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(The girl holding the stuffed animal is slightly startled, but calmly steps back and observes the situation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you a drifter?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes? Who do you think is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Can't you see the person in front of me? He's holding a doll with pink hair... .
(After confirming that Ricotta does not recognize her, the girl quickly runs away in the opposite direction.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, over there! Wait a minute!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ricotta, I need to talk to him for a moment.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … What on earth did you see? Have you seen a ghost... ? Ah, let’s go together!!

steps.name: Travel writers from different continents
steps.objective: Defeat [Figma No.1] and [Socks Sheep] in “Aie Island.” Then report the quest to [Yeonhee] on “Aie Island.”

lines.text: There must be a road to the imperial capital... . No matter how much I walk around, I can't see the path. There is nothing but dolls... .
Why can't I see it like this? Ah, glasses… . The dolls took it away earlier... .
But it’s okay because I brought another one!
(The woman takes out a pair of glasses from her arms and puts them on. Then, she opens the map in her diary and checks her surroundings.)
A place that isn't even on the map. Was it because of bad luck on Hyeon’s part that we ended up in a place like this? Phew, think about that later.
Let's write it down first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, can you hear me?
(The woman was so busy writing something down in her diary that she couldn't see the person in front of her or hear what they were saying.)
(After a while, the woman, who felt that she was being loved, closes the diary and looks ahead. There are two people looking at her curiously, but they don't seem to care much.)
Hello. Have you two been on a trip too?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … You are not an ordinary person. You bring up the word ‘travel’ here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By any chance, have you seen the girl passing by here?
No, I didn't see it... . What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it... . uh? Hey, you're from Elias, right? Looking at it, it’s their doubles… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Elias? I heard it's a city on the Gyendia continent.
Yes, that's right. I am from Elias on the continent of Gendia. Oh, let me introduce myself. My name is Yeonhee. My job is to travel and write.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It looks familiar... . Haven’t you been to Duterbi Village before? Your name is %s… , right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Oh, that's right. That's right. You were there... . I couldn't talk properly back then.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's okay. We can continue our relationship from now on.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: My name is Ricotta, a knight helping the Imperial Castle of the Sylvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Nice to meet you, knight.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You can just call me Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I was passing through eastern Freios and heading west. I heard you can use the Nereis Gateway Gate.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I heard that if you take the gate, you can pass through the ruins of the west and go to Glaston... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: When I came through the gate... . It was here. It's not the road to the west, and it's not even on the map.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: As I walked around, I saw that the name of this place was Ai… I found out that it is said.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: The dolls said welcome to Aie Island and tried to take her away. There was something strange about it, so I threw it all away, but it still felt a little uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aie Island… ?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's my first time hearing this name. But you killed the dolls here? Now that I think about it, the dolls here are the same ones that appeared at the gateway... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If you can handle that... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's enough to protect my body.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did those dolls want to take you?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I don't know about that either. There is a stage, but there is no one to act, or something like that... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: This is my first time in a situation like this, so I think I need to write it down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In a way, you're drifting, but you're so calm.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thanks to my cousin, who has been causing misfortune since I was young, I stopped being surprised by most things.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: By the way, why not collect some information about the dolls that appear? Then, I think you can find out what kind of place Aie Island is... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Then, why don’t we sort it out together?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeonhee, please wait here.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Since ancient times, travel is meaningful in terms of first-hand experience. I will follow you too.
(Yeonhee, who was walking forward, falls down in place as if she hit something. Ricotta, startled, approaches and helps Yeonhee up.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Are you okay? Ah, this… . wait a minute.
(As Ricotta extends his hand forward, a wave of unknown power appears like a wave around him.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There is a kind of barrier in place. Neither I nor Yeonhee can approach... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I can get over it for now... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It can't be helped. Let’s wait here like %s said. I have something for you to do for me.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: … Please gather information about the doll here. Then I will quickly analyze the doll.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I guess so. I'll go first. In the meantime, Rico stay with Yeonhee.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Don't worry. Even though it looks like this, I am strong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will ask you a favor.

steps.name: Spirit holding a doll
steps.objective: Defeat [Red Controller] and [Negligent Focalo] on “Aie Island.” Then report the quest to [Hayden] on “Aie Island.”

lines.text: (Yeonhee is sitting in front of the lifeless dolls that have fallen down and looking around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you feel? Did you find out anything? .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You're continuing to look, but there's no answer yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, it must be difficult to figure out something in such a short period of time.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Did %s find out something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As Yeonhee said, the dolls said they had no one to act and tried to take them away.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Would you two please come here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeonhee? Did you find out something?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's not a big deal, but I found something very small.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: These dolls seem to look the same, but if you look for them, they are slightly different.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: The heights are different, and the sizes of body parts such as the head and body are also different. And I feel the pain... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I knew it wasn't a normal doll, but this was like... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: So you're saying it's like a person, or rather a living thing?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Yes… . You might say this is nonsense, but... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I believe it. The world we live in has many things that don't make sense... . I thought Yeonhee was scared, so I just knocked her out.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, step back!
(Ricotta comes to the front of the group and swings a large lance. However, the lance seems to be blocked by something and bounces back.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Ugh… .
You don't have to do that. Spirits don't harm humans.
(The girl looks at the group with her odd-eye eyes shining like jewels. After a while, she waves the hand of the doll she is holding in greeting.)
Hello… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirit… ? Looking at the wings, it looks like a spirit... .
Can I take these dolls back?
I'll talk to you so that the dolls don't force you to take them.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … This doll was trying to capture us and take us somewhere.
I'm sorry. Please understand that those dolls were just doing their job and didn't do anything wrong.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: … Since he just asked me to understand and didn't say anything else, I guess there's something there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if we don't let them take this doll?
It can't be helped. Since you won't let me take care of the doll, I'll go back.
(The spirit waves the doll's hand again to say hello. Then it quickly turns around and flies away somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stand there! Stop!

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: … I don't think it will come back.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I think it would be better to meet that spirit and talk to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico and Yeonhee, would you mind waiting here? I'll go to that spirit and find a way.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't want to let you go alone, but I have no choice. First of all, together with Yeonhee, we will look for some helpful information about the doll.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'll wait here. Ah, there you go.
(As %s disappears inside the island, Yeonhee checks the surroundings and opens the diary.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: First of all, I think we need to write down what happened here.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Hey, ricotta… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Please speak, Yeonhee.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: You said earlier that the disappeared spirits do not harm humans. That means… . Is there something here that can harm humans?

steps.name: a singing warrior
steps.objective: After talking with [Hayden] in “Aie Island,” enter the “Abyss Mirror” and defeat [Scylla]. Then return to [Hayden] and report the quest.

lines.text: I didn't know you'd come this far.
(The disappeared spirit makes eye contact with Adventurer as if it had been waiting.)
Uh… . You are loved by the goddess. I am Hayden, a spirit that exists for dolls. Oh, this child is called Marie. Marie, I have to say hello.
(The spirit introduced as Hayden moves the doll's hand and says hello again.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Then you must be %s. I should have recognized it right away, but since I've been on this island for a long time and haven't met any other spirits, it was a bit late to figure it out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where on earth is this?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: This is Aie, the island of happy dolls.
(Hayden smiles brightly and lifts Marie's hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Island of Aie?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It was originally a longer name, but it was simply called Ai… I ended up saying this.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Even before the continent of Freios ascended to the sky, this place was an island. The waves were high, making it difficult to approach even by boat.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The owner of the island once chose a special day to calm the waves so that people could come, and luckily they survived the whirlpool.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I was very lucky to be able to rise and maintain that form even in the sea of magical power.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The owner of the island liked his customers so much that he even built a theater. Check it out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A theater? Ah, not this. Has anyone other than my group ever come?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw a girl on my way here. Have you seen her? That person, like Hayden, was holding a doll.
(Hayden's mouth stops chattering.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I can't tell you that. If you want to know, go to Him. That's not something a spirit like me can say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If a spirit is a person of an indescribable level, is it a higher being?... Just like Barbatos, who restrained Michaela...)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: If that's not the case, I'll tell you as much as I want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to ask a question that will give me an answer...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marie doesn't move any differently than the other dolls here.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes… ? A doll is essentially a non-moving entity, right?
(Hayden momentarily lifts Marie's hand to cover his mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These dolls wander around this island and say they need someone to act... . The spirit that takes care of those dolls... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirits don't work unless it's life, so that means... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, where should I go to meet ‘Him’?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I… , I am… … .
(Hayden sits down without saying anything. Then he quietly uses Marie's hand to point somewhere.)
(Something that I didn't recognize until a moment ago comes into view. A tree with a broken mirror on it, and the doll's head in front of it give me an ominous feeling.)
(The moment Adventurer's vision focuses inward, someone's image is slightly reflected through the broken mirror.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like that girl from before. Why is she there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, tell me one thing.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I go into the mirror?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You can enter two places where the plush head is placed. With [Mirror of the Abyss] and [Eugamon Theater]... . First, approach the mirror… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, that is the [Abyss Mirror]... . all right. Then Hayden waits here.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes… .
(As he approaches the broken mirror, the light flowing from somewhere leads Adventurer to a space different from the island.)
(The mysterious space with sparkling glass beads, walls, and pillars makes you forget about the island you were on just a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a place that only exists in your imagination. Mirror of the Abyss... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? Where did these dolls come from?
(When the dolls appear, they come closer and gather around %s. A girl approaches %s, who is embarrassed by the appearance of the dolls.)
Everyone step back. This is someone who might become a new member.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is not the kid who ran away from the island...)
(The dolls scatter at the gesture of the girl, who is wearing a doll hat and has parts of her body like dolls.)
My name is Scylla.
(A girl with one arm and leg like a doll and wearing a hat-like doll head introduces herself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Scylla?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I am Scylla, playing the role of the puppet knight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The doll knight?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Let's see. What role are you suited for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to ask, what are you doing here? I think a girl holding a doll came in in front of me... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: The role that suits you is... . You're a witch! That role is now empty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You know that villains usually appear last, right? I will be preparing all this time, so I need to practice well and get to where I am.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: It's hard, but you'll have to do it well. Only then will you be on the stage of this theater, not in this abyss.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: See you later then.
(When Scylla, who had no intention of hearing %s's story, disappeared like that, all nearby dolls also disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? He just says what he wants to say and disappears... . What should I do if I say that I am playing the role of a puppet knight and speak as if I am really acting? . uh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a little strange... . Could it be that he was acting out what he did to me? It seemed a bit strange to say he was acting... . uh?
(A girl's image is reflected between the huge glass pillars inside. The girl's image then appears in other mirrors, beads, and pillars.)
(It appears to be the pink-haired girl who ran away after making eye contact on the island.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that kid who ran away still there?
(Then the girl meets %s's eyes and makes a sad expression. Then, she purses her mouth as if she is about to say something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying? Save me? uh… .
(Little by little, the girl’s appearance becomes blurred and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's gone. Ah, it must be somewhere in this space... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the 'person' Hayden was talking about is Scylla, we need to meet him quickly. Let's go quickly.
(After avoiding many dolls that were attacking us and wandering around for a while in a space made of glass and mirrors, we arrived at a dead end...)
(Scylla is waiting in front of him with her head bowed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Scylla… ?
(When her name is called, Scylla slowly walks forward and begins to sing a song with an atmosphere that does not fit the space.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I was waiting, witch♬

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You probably thought that if you cursed people and ran away, you wouldn't be found♪

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I expected it, but he's acting here... but he's not good at singing.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You mistakenly thought you were unhappy♬ You could have never become a witch... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Your choice has touched the stuck gear of misfortune♩

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You probably regretted it too. No, it would be nice if you regret it ♬ Since you started using the curse, you~!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whose story is this… is it really a witch’s story?)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: The kind owner of the island took pity on you and let you stay here... .
(The mirror behind Scylla moves violently. A black shadow sways as if someone is trapped inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… . The mirror behind me... . Could it be that the child is trapped?
(He pushes away Scylla, who is immersed in acting, and tries to approach the mirror, but is blocked by an unknown force.)
(At that time, Scylla holds %s's back and continues singing again.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: But you!! Dare, dare!!
(Scylla takes a moment to catch her breath and looks at Adventurer, who was chosen to play the witch.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I am a warrior who fought and won against demons in a land forsaken by the gods♬ I dreamed of a future on this island with the person I love... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I couldn't turn into a doll, so I barely held on... .
(Suddenly, Scylla, who was singing, falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Scylla?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Scylla, stop singing now.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Who would have thought that the puppet knight would sing this song even though he was turned into a doll? it's annoying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Of course, Skillage!

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Scylla, come to your senses. You have to act properly with the member in charge of the role.
(Scylla's eyes become blurred as if she has lost focus. Then, she raises the sword in her hand and approaches at high speed.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Hehe, let the attack begin☆
(Scylla catches the incoming attack of %s with her bare hands.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I don't know who it is, but I've come to my senses now. Let's stop this fight, trust me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I believe it?
(Scylla releases her hand from %s's weapon and turns her back.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: It is impossible for a knight to give his back to an enemy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … all right. I'll believe it. But who controlled you?
(Scylla approaches the mirror where someone seems to be trapped. Then, she raises an arm that looks like a doll and strikes the mirror.)
Clink!
(The mirror breaks and cracks with a sharp sound. As the pieces fall to the floor, a person who appears to have been trapped inside is visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That's right, it's that kid.
(A pink-haired girl, holding a stuffed animal-shaped toy in her arms, sits down trembling.)
Thank you for saving me... .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Who saves whom? You're acting until the end.
(An angry Scylla reaches out and grabs the frightened girl.)
Save me... .
(The girl looks at Adventurer with sad eyes.)
Why are you still?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are not good at acting.
Yeah?
(A smile that had not been seen before spreads across the girl's face. Scylla's eyes have changed again and she puts down the girl she was holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you and what is Scylla?
What do you mean by looking at people? I am Circe, the resident of this island and the owner of the dolls on the island. Skillado is my doll.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The doll owner?
(The girl who introduced herself as Circe shakes the hand of the doll in her arms like Hayden.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes, the doll master. The doll and I have been together since birth. Of course, we are still together now. Hehe, there is no doll that doesn't listen to me.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: But I couldn't believe Scylla was attacking me. So I just used my abilities. I want to know if the witch still controls Scylla... .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Thank goodness. It was released at some point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think this kid is the ‘him’ Hayden was talking about… First of all, I don’t think he’s that threatening.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then why did you run away when you saw me in the forest?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I was running away using camouflage, but you recognized me. That's why I was surprised. You ended up getting caught and locked up here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where is the witch? Why did I keep you here?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: That's what I want to know. This is a bunch of question marks.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. It's thanks to you that all the dolls weren't taken away. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I'm going out, you're not going out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Scylla… ?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: This is like a doll warehouse, and Scylla is a doll, so don't worry about it.
(As soon as Circe finishes speaking, Scylla falls to the floor. Circe, seeing this, smiles lightly as if nothing has happened and turns her back.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Then bye bye☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that child really the doll’s owner?)
(As I was examining Scylla's condition, I heard Circe muttering to herself, the meaning of which is unknown.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: They say it's because of [Walpurgis Night], but aren't they all pushing too hard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Circe, wait a minute!
(Circe's voice can no longer be heard. She is not even seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does Circe know that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go to Hayden first. Hayden seems to know something... . Oh, that's right. Scylla… .
(Adventurer gets Scylla up, makes her sit against the wall, and hurries out. After a while, Scylla comes to her senses and sobs in a painful voice.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: … Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Ugh, the Adventurer of the goddess… . If you go on stage as Circe wants... , no… .

steps.name: senior member of the theater
steps.objective:
1. After talking with [Hayden] in 「Aie Island」, enter 「Eugamon Theater」.
2. Defeat [Glaucus]. Acquire <Epistle of Aie Island>. 
3. Return to [Hayden] and report the quest.

lines.text: (Even when you come out of the mirror, the broken mirror remains, and the scenery of the island where the dolls roam is the same. Hayden is still standing in the same place on the path you passed by.)
(Hayden shakes stuffed animal Marie's hand as if he has something to say.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Could it be… , have you met?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What I met was Circe and Scylla, who Circe said was a doll... , there are two.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now tell me. Who is ‘the one’ Hayden was talking about? .  Wait a minute, what is that thread?
(Only then can we see the white thread wrapping around Hayden's neck. The thread is even wrapped around Hayden as if it were tying everything around him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was this why you couldn't talk about it? Wait a minute, Hayden... .
(Adventurer's hand cuts off the threads wrapped around Hayden's neck and body. Hayden's previously stiff face begins to show a liveliness that I have never seen before.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you for cutting the thread that bound my body. I couldn't do anything because of this thread.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I didn't want to be a lying spirit like Echo, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Echo?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A spirit that lies to the gods is not viewed favorably even among the spirits. By the way, %s, do you see that thread?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I say? I suddenly saw it.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A witch's true power is visible only to those affected by her power. %s, do you know any witches?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch I know... It's a bit strange to say that, but... . There is one person. He's on Iris's side.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I think other spirits said that too. %s also said that, so it must be true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean Circe is a witch? You said you were the owner of the doll... . Oh, no way… … .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Everything you imagine is correct. And I'm waiting for someone

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who on earth is that?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: That's it... . Ugh, wow!!
(The moment Hayden is about to answer, he suddenly complains of pain and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden? Hayden!! What's wrong? This is again... . Just wait a moment. I'll cut it off... .
Because the manager wouldn't leave behind someone who was interfering with the stage. Oh, sorry.
(The gaze naturally moves following the clearly heard voice. A young man with a bizarre appearance, like Scylla, with parts of his body in the shape of a doll, looks at Adventurer with blank eyes.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: This is Glaucus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glaucus… ?
(The young man smiles softly upon hearing the name Glaucus.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: That person is the owner of the island... . However, after being cursed by the doll... .
(Hayden loses consciousness before he can finish speaking.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I don't know what that spirit is talking about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here now?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I was waiting for you, the new member. There was already a role that suited me, so I was going to recommend it.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I play the role of a hero who fights monsters. Haha, it's perfect for you, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like Scylla, Glaucus also thinks he is an actor... then...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what role did you play?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Of course, as a senior member, I am the main character. He is an unlucky man who tried to save the woman he loved, but was cursed and turned into a monster.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The righteous hero tries to defeat this man because he just seems like a monster.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now, how about it? Would you please come up on this stage?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'd like to sum it up in advance, but I don't have much time. Since this stage is an improvisational play, there is a strong tendency to rely on the actor's sense.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then I will dress up appropriately and wait. When you're ready, come inside the Eugamon Theater you can see over there and join in on the other members' acting.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Whether the protagonist can break the curse is up to you.
(Glaucus smiles lightly with blank eyes. Then he turns his back and slowly disappears through the theater door.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Scylla and Glaucus also acted like actors on a stage... . Hayden also acted while he was tied up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like a puppet show made by a witch….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, but… what happens when the main character lifts the curse? What about this island…?)
(As I was sorting out my mind, which was full of various thoughts, the rabbit doll next to Hayden, who was lying down, came into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marie, please wait with Hayden for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? Did I see it wrong? I think I nodded that I understood...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go to the theater. The answer will be there.
(As you enter the box that looks like a door, an incredible scenery unfolds before your eyes.)
(The stage with seats covered in red velvet and a background structure makes you realize that this is a theater.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, what is here... . The atmosphere is different. I think I would believe it even if the actors were acting here.
(As I was looking at the stage, there was a commotion inside the stage. An unfamiliar girl was surrounded by a group of dolls and was confused.)
What is it? What about these dolls? what? Why are you holding on to me?
Wait, you guys… . It's not a doll. I thought I could hide here, so I came... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just wait a moment. Let me help you.
You are the key... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: key? Why do you call me Key?
We shouldn't meet like this... . Consciousness becomes blurred... . You are better than me... .
(The dolls catch the stumbling girl and quickly take her somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stand there!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did they go? Clearly there is only one road ahead... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Circe's abilities are like that, we need to go quickly. I don't have time to be like this... .
(So Adventurer goes off stage to look for the girl, and Glaucus' narration flows from the stage as if it was planned.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스의 목소리
lines.text: Meanwhile, the hero who came to the island sees a woman being dragged by a monster right in front of him and decides to go rescue her... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스의 목소리
lines.text: Until then, the hero did not know. This is all someone's prank... .
(While the atmosphere of the stage continues to change, many puppets repeatedly appear and disappear in front of %s as if acting.)
(And so the play heads to the end, and the stage that appears to be the finale is finally set up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the end?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: On a bright moonlit night, the sea shining outside the mansion... . It's romantic. What does it look like outside the island? no… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The outside of the island is a magical vortex with nothing in it... .
(A huge shadow appears behind %s, who was looking outside.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It is impossible for a knight to give his back to an enemy. Come on, brave man. Look at me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glaucus… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute, this line... I think it was said by Scylla...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Brave man. Thank you for your hard work coming here. Now listen to my story.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Everything you know is a misunderstanding. I am sacrificing a woman... . That's what witches do!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch… .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: But, you must have believed that I did it all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now Glaucus is acting. According to the script...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Even though I look like a monster now, this is not my original appearance. It's a curse... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I thought I would be cursed for my loved one, but... , the one I love was also cursed and became like this. And I got stuck somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This can’t be right….)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You who came this far must have a mission. For your justice.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: But, I also have a reason to be here.
(Glaucus holds up the weapon in his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel a strong force... There is definitely a will to fight, and more accurately, it is inducing a fight. That means...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you want, defeat me who has become a monster. I want you to show me your justice... .

lines.speaker: 키르케의 목소리
lines.text: Glaucus, stop!! Please don't do that!!
(Circe's voice screaming is heard from somewhere. Then, dolls come from somewhere and try to attack the two people.)
(However, thanks to the magic barrier deployed by Glaucus, the dolls melt and disappear on the spot.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This situation right now... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: %s… , errand boy beloved by God. Now the play I prepared has come to an end. I just want you to finish it.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Lifting the curse placed by Circe is the final story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: kill me Then, this space, which contains all my power as the owner of the island, will trap Circe forever.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you do that, you can safely return home with the others.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Otherwise... . Ugh, ugh, Circe, stop it!! key… , Leque… .
(Glaucus's eyes lose focus as he continues the story, and he begins to speak in a different voice, like a doll representing someone.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I hate it, Glaucus☆

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: %s, I don't care if you're God's messenger or whatever. Because you became an inconvenience to me anyway.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now you know what I'm going to do, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to know.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'm annoyed... . it's annoying. You're annoying!
(Someone who had invaded Glaucus' consciousness continued to pour out his emotions in his mouth, as if he was not satisfied with the answer.)
(That only lasts for a moment, and the owner of the doll just informs the person who will become the doll once again, as always.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'll tell you, just like this, you will quietly become a member of the puppet show! Just like Scylla and Glaucus did!!
(As %s continues to struggle, something sparkling in the light comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's the thread!
(Adventurer takes advantage of Glaucus's weakness and cuts all the threads that bound him. Then, the owner of the island, who has exhausted all his strength, collapses.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Ugh… . Ugh, this place… . What am I… .
(Glaucus barely sits up, his voice struggling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Glaucus?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You can rest assured. Because Circe can't influence me anymore. Seeing as I've come to my senses, Circe's thread will have all disappeared.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you don't believe me, you can just kill me like this.
(Glaucus' seemingly resigned expression shows an inexplicable loneliness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I can't do that.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I can go on with my life, but I can't stop Circe. Oh, I don't blame you.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If this is everyone's fate, then so be it.

lines.speaker: 키르케의 목소리
lines.text: Stop it, Glaucus!!
(Needles and threads fly out from afar along with Circe's voice, but they are blocked by the magical barrier that is still in place.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Don't pay attention to what that kid says. At this moment, this stage has become completely mine, a place that even the witch's pranks can't touch.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now I would like to speak to you, the new messenger of God. Only then will God recognize their existence.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now, ask me what you want to know… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…I have a lot to ask. Which one should I ask first?)

choices.text: 1. About Glaucus, the owner of the island

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I am Glaucus, the master of the island. It is the incarnation of an ancient god whose name has even been forgotten.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Don't be so surprised. You have probably already met someone similar to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that? No, if it’s the incarnation of God, it’s not unreasonable for you to already know it… .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I was once with them too... . It's natural to feel changes in the world... . Even though I was an incarnation, God wanted me to love this place and live there.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: He gave me will as a gift, and he returned to his original place far away. I have stayed here since then.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The beautiful island is always crowded with many guests visiting the continent. I felt like this was what it was like to be alive, so I prepared a lot for them.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The conflict between the gods and the twisted began, and as the continent split in half and rose into the sky, Aie Island became hidden somewhere and became invisible.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Although there were no more guests on the island, I was writing a play for those who would visit someday. This stage and theater are all for God and life... .
(Glaucus looks around the stage filled with magic barriers.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It was such a stage, but I ended up making such a mess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was Scylla also a resident here?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Scylla was a warrior and knight who hunted demons that appeared on the Continent of Freios. While I was going somewhere on a balloon, I was swept away by a magical vortex and fell onto an island.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: When she was found, she was so shocked that she couldn't wake up. I took care of her for a long time hoping she would wake up.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I woke up after a long time, but the time in the world had changed a lot... . She couldn't help but be disappointed.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Still, Scylla quickly got up and adapted to this island. They enjoyed reading my script and sympathized with it. He said it was fun and we shared our feelings for a long time.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It's been a long time already. Due to the influence of magical power, time in Scylla's body has stopped, so time has become meaningless... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Still, we were happy during that time. But, Circe appears... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I couldn't protect Scyllado or this island properly, and I couldn't overcome the doll's curse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Still, you held on and woke up like this.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Okay, that's why I survived at least this way to tell you... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: While walking around the island with Scylla, I felt a strong magical energy from somewhere... . We quickly headed there.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: There was a girl lying there. Still, when I got up, I quickly came to my senses and got up.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: He looked around and smiled brightly, and there didn't seem to be any major problems. So he stayed with us for a while.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: He didn't tell us anything other than the name Circe, but we were fine. We tried to help him recover and come back.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: In the meantime, I had forgotten about the strong magical power I felt when that child appeared... . Who would have thought that would hold us back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: He was jealous of our relationship, asking me to be his only friend. I couldn't tell what he was feeling, but he seemed quite anxious.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: So we tried to send Circe back. I didn't think this was a good place for Circe to be.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: However, Circe kept coming back, and her obsession with us grew stronger. Then, by chance, I came across Circe's abilities.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I thought he was hiding something... .  I never thought it would have that kind of ability... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Circe's hidden ability is to turn anything she wants into a doll... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Scylla realized that it was an ability that came from the demon world and tried to persuade Circe, but it was already too late.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Part of Scylla's body had already been turned into a doll and was controlled by Circe. I also tried to deal with Circe, but even I, the incarnation, was powerless... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I asked Circe to protect her. I asked her not to do this, but Circe didn't stop. Instead, he said that.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Glaucus, ask Scylla to receive all the remaining curses... . Why do you only see yourself as a witch? .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I guess this is the end of the story. At this level, God will be able to accept this situation. Circe has disappeared... .
(Circe, standing outside the magic barrier, does not appear to have disappeared.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Since his power no longer works here, there is no need for him to be here.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Are there any more people who came here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are two of us, one who drifted away and one who came with me.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then you take this and hurry to Hayden. Then Circe will no longer have any influence on this island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. But, what is this?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It is a keystone that is the foundation of Aie Island. I packed it in advance just in case. Now, Adventurer, beloved by God… . Take it to Hayden, the island spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hayden wasn't originally a doll spirit either.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll take it out right away.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You worked hard. I'm going to look for Scylla, so please be careful when I return... . I'll go see Hayden later... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then be careful. Should I go now too… .
(As %s is about to leave the theater, a girl appears in front of her. She is the same girl who was kidnapped by the doll when she entered the theater.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, over there… , are you okay? You were kidnapped by the dolls earlier.
When I came to my senses, I was fine, Key. Oh, sorry. The words I sing to myself are stuck in my mouth... .
Thank you. For not letting me become a doll... . If I had become a doll, everything in this world might have ended... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about, but there's no need to be thankful. Let's go out together first. The road here... .
No, I can't go with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, why?
Because we can't be together. instead… . I'll tell you my name.
My name is Hilda. There's no need to remember. Because I will never see you again. And I won't appear before you again,
(A shadow slowly rises in front of the girl who introduces herself as Hilda. After a while, the girl's appearance disappears everywhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, where did you go? He said a lot of unknown things... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's think about it later and go straight to Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Are you okay, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden? are you okay?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I'm fine, but %s lost consciousness as soon as he saw me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? Uh, I came in front of Hayden and definitely delivered something... .

lines.text: It's because so many things happen here. Thanks to %s, I was able to completely escape from the doll thread.

lines.text: A day has passed.

lines.text: Wait a minute. One day?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes… , I think it was probably the witch's power that had an effect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what happened to the other people who were here with me?
