lines.text: The knight who uses Twisted Darkness recognized me and explained it to me. He said he understood and cleaned up the place with a person wearing glasses.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Before that, people who had been turned into dolls by Circe's curse returned to their original form. So he took everyone and took them off the island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good thing... , are the people who were turned into dolls okay?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I have some physical issues, but I think that can be resolved by taking some time to rest. And I have no memories of when I became a doll. Don't worry too much... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Scylla and Glaucus are also resting comfortably. Not now, but please come back later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I, too, was glad to be able to meet a person of the goddess like this. When the time comes, I will also go see Iris.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Adventurer, and… … … … .
(Hayden keeps saying something, but %s can't hear anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, what? Could you say it again? I can't hear well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, this is... .
(Suddenly, Hayden's figure disappears from sight without a trace. Instead, the figure of Circe, a witch who does not hide her ominous power, appears.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: %s, I don't like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Circe!!
(He quickly approaches Circe, but is blocked by a barrier.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Even if you scream like that, you can’t do anything in this space. Of course, I can't do anything either... .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: How dare you release the blessing on my friend. I really don't like it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you want to talk about? That's a blessing?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes, blessing. You ruined it all.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: This is a place where I need to be loved. It's a place where there are dolls that love me and that I love!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: So why are you trying to ruin me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Did you turn people who helped you into dolls because you wanted to be loved?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes☆

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I needed a friend to play with. I just needed a loving family... .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: All I could do for a day like this was that God granted my wish. He gave me the ability to make friends because I didn't have any friends around me!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: But why? Why don't you love me? Why don't you love me?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Instead, everyone tried to kill me because they said I was cursed. What on earth did I do... . What's wrong with my abilities... .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Then I came here, and there was someone who reached out to me, hehe.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Scyllado and Glaucus are good friends☆ I really like Glaucus.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I would be better suited to Glaucus than to Scylla, but Glaucus refused. joy. What's wrong with me? Now Glaucus and Scylla are bye☆

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: But I have better friends than them. So we were playing together and tried to make it into a doll, but you messed it up?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Hmph, I don’t like it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about that green haired girl?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes, that's right. You saw it too. For a witch to come here to hide is too sloppy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…I said Hilda…but she was a witch….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So why did you try to turn that girl into a doll?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Ugh, that’s because she’s a witch☆

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Wasn't that what people said she had to do because she was a witch?
(Circe looks at %s's face with an expression of complete ignorance.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Just like Pandora made Luceria like that, I have to make it like that too. Otherwise, I too will die☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Now that I've told my story, I'll listen to yours too.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Try it. I will listen to everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to hear it, so I'll tell you. You're a fool who can't even decide whether it's love, sympathy, or attraction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Look what you did. Do you think it was a good thing to be loved? Your ability was cursed from the moment it caused pain to others.
(Circe's expression becomes distorted for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: It's noisy, it's loud!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: You're going to die anyway!! I'm going to turn you into a doll before someone kills you!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: That way, even the goddess who loves you will forget your existence!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I will throw you as a toy to the devil!! The doll with the cotton ball bursting out will look just like you, so look forward to it!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Ahahaha!! Ahahaha!! Ahahahaha!!
(Circe, who seemed angry, bursts out into maniacal laughter. After a while, the space where the two were standing begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: … Then you go back to your world. I'm going to my world. I don't want to see you again, but you already have a connection with a witch... .

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Even if you don't like it, you'll see it again. Because Walpurgis Night will lead you.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Goodbye then, my friend who will definitely be my doll next time☆

lines.text: %s, there is no need to tell Yeonhee the details.

lines.text: Aha. If that's the case, there's nothing you can do about it. I won't talk about the doll.

lines.text: I was adrift. That's why you brought back the people who were stranded on the island, including me.

lines.text: Thanks to you, my memories of Aie Island became a good experience. I'm glad I was able to leave it on record.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, Yeonhee.

lines.text: (For now, I have no choice but to believe that they can do it like that.)

lines.text: We will meet again. %s, Rico.
